comment: Frozen expectations about which corpus cases the attribution engine does NOT yet satisfy. This is the 'permanent memory' of known attribution defects: the set may only shrink, and a change in either direction must be made deliberately here and explained in the task report. 'wrongOwnerAtHighOrConfirmed' is the number that matters most - how many confident ownership claims are wrong. It must never increase. Task 04 record: the unresolved set stayed at 15 because the false positives are still accepted owners, but 'wrongOwnerAtHighOrConfirmed' fell from 11 to 0 and 'highOrConfirmedClaims' from 20 to 4. That is the intended shape of progress - honest MEDIUM results rose, confidently wrong claims disappeared. Removing those false-positive candidates entirely is Task 05's job (the filesystem semantic layer), not Task 04's.
